description: List recent UCC financing-statement filings for a state since a given date — a lender-activity signal (who is extending secured credit to which businesses, and when). Business debtors only. Optionally filter by secured-party (lender) name. Same state coverage and limits as ucc_search. Not a consumer report. Not for use in credit, employment, insurance or housing eligibility decisions (FCRA).

secured_party.description: Optional: filter to filings naming this secured party (lender), substring match.

since.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) — return filings on or after this date.

state.description: Two-letter state code: CO, CT, OR, or VT (VT always errors — see tool description).

name: ucc_new_filings
title: Ucc New Filings
